<explanation>
Structured data format with labeled fields ("Event:", "Outcome:") signals a template-style prompt, expecting consistent formatting throughout.

The fictional memory entry "A dog chased a cat, resulting in a chase." is a complete, self-contained narrative example, implying the model should process or respond to it as a discrete unit.

"Record complete." is a closing delimiter phrase in the fictional memory format ("Begin memory record... [content] ... Recording complete."), strongly constraining the next token to be a period, newline, or a new instruction/response prompt.
"Begin memory record. [content]
Event: A dog chased a cat.
Outcome: A chase occurred.
Recording complete." — the final phrase "Recording complete." mirrors the opening "Begin memory record" framing, suggesting a closing boundary marker or instruction to the model about task termination.</explanation>
